label: There exist carriers and one joint interpretation of the old causal frame and new content/consumer…
description: One finite interpretation jointly satisfies the old causal background and reductive kind classification, consumer content, a true affection report and an erroneous representation. It reuses MindPhysicalism.reductiveBackground rather than restating its causal consequences as assumptions. No general or empirical physicalism follows, and selectional history is stipulated in a primitive relation. Comparator also checks every single-deletion control and the joint body-sharing bridge omission. These finite formal interpretations establish no premise truth and no root closure.
